app.title: Setup Toolbox
update.available.title: Update available
update.installing: Installing — the app will close and restart automatically...
update.failed.title: Update failed
toast.schedule.title: Automatic updates are enabled
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.title: App language
settings.language.desc: Changes the language of the interface. Applies immediately — the app does not need to restart.
settings.schedule.title: Scheduled auto-updates
settings.schedule.active: A scheduled auto-update task is active. Winget upgrades all apps automatically on the configured trigger.
settings.schedule.notScheduled: Not scheduled. Configure a Windows Task Scheduler entry that runs 'winget upgrade --all' silently on a recurring schedule.
settings.schedule.disableConfirm.title: Disable auto-updates?
settings.schedule.disableConfirm.body: This removes the Windows scheduled task. You can re-create it any time.
settings.schedule.disabled.title: Auto-updates disabled
settings.schedule.disabled.body: The scheduled task has been removed.
settings.schedule.disableFailed.title: Could not disable
settings.schedule.disableFailed.body: schtasks.exe could not delete the task (the admin prompt was denied, or schtasks returned an error).
settings.notifications.title: Notifications for automatic updates
settings.notifications.desc: Shows a notification in the corner when the scheduled run checks for updates, and afterwards which apps were updated. Click the notification to open the app.
settings.fallback.title: Open vendor download pages
settings.fallback.desc: When installing apps that aren't on winget (badged 'Manual download'), open the vendor's download page in your default browser. Disable to skip these apps during install.
settings.parallel.title: Parallel installs
settings.parallel.desc: How many apps to install at the same time (1–4). Higher is faster for regular installers, but MSI installers still serialize and higher counts mean more UAC prompts. 1 = one at a time.
settings.leftovers.title: Scan for leftovers after uninstall
settings.leftovers.desc: After a successful uninstall, scan registry uninstall keys, Program Files folders and AppData folders for leftover traces. Always a preview first — nothing is deleted without confirmation.
settings.selection.title: Export / import selection
settings.selection.desc: Save your current selection to a JSON file and reload it on a fresh install or share it with a friend.
settings.selection.nothing.title: Nothing to export
settings.selection.nothing.body: You have no apps selected right now. Pick a few on the Apps page first.
settings.selection.exported.title: Selection exported
settings.selection.exportFailed.title: Export failed
settings.selection.importFailed.title: Import failed
settings.selection.imported.title: Selection imported
settings.selection.imported.bodySkipped: {0} selected, {1} not found in the current catalog.
settings.profiles.title: Create / import a tweak profile
settings.profiles.desc: Put together your own set of tweaks — 'Create profile' opens the Tweaks tab with everything unchecked; tick what you want and save it to a file. 'Import' stages the tweaks from a profile as pending changes (tweaks that are already active are skipped), after which you click Apply on the Tweaks tab.
settings.profiles.importFailed.title: Import failed
settings.profiles.noKnown.title: No known tweaks
settings.profiles.noKnown.body: This file contains no tweaks that exist in this version{0}.
settings.profiles.allGood.title: Everything is already set
settings.profiles.allGood.body: All {0} in this profile are already in the desired state — nothing to apply.
settings.profiles.imported.title: Profile imported
settings.profiles.imported.body:
{0}

Go to the Tweaks tab to apply them?
settings.profiles.ready.title: Staged
settings.profiles.ready.body: {0} Open the Tweaks tab and click Apply.
settings.backup.title: Backup before Tweaks Apply
settings.backup.desc: We take a snapshot of every registry value your Tweaks selection touches, before the Apply. The 'Restore previous state' button on the Tweaks tab then puts everything back exactly as it was.
settings.restore.deepClean.title: Restore point before Deep Clean
settings.restore.deepClean.desc: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every delete batch. One UAC prompt for the whole scenario (checkpoint + delete together).
settings.restore.deepClean.descWithAge: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every delete batch. The last restore point was {0} ago.
settings.restore.debloat.title: Restore point before Debloat
settings.restore.debloat.desc: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every uninstall batch. Catches OEM driver or Windows feature regressions.
settings.restore.debloat.descWithAge: Create a Windows System Restore Point before every uninstall batch. The last restore point was {0} ago.
settings.restore.manage.title: Manage / roll back restore points
settings.restore.manage.desc: Opens the Windows System Restore wizard where you can pick an earlier restore point to roll your system back to. A reboot is required for the actual restore.
settings.restore.protectionOff.title: System Protection is off
settings.restore.protectionOff.body: Restore points cannot be created without System Protection enabled for your system drive. Open System Properties > System Protection to turn it on.
settings.restore.rateLimited.tooltip: The last restore point was {0} ago. Windows skips new points within 24h — the checkpoint step will be silently skipped on the next Deep Clean/Debloat.
settings.restore.wizardFailed.title: Could not open the System Restore wizard
settings.updateCheck.title: Check for updates at startup
settings.updateCheck.desc: Quietly checks GitHub for a newer version when the app starts. If it finds one, an update bar appears at the top.
settings.welcomeBanner.title: Welcome banner on the Apps page
settings.welcomeBanner.desc: Shows a short explanatory banner at the top of the Apps page. Off as soon as you dismiss it.
settings.checkNow.title: Check for updates now
settings.checkNow.available.title: Update available
settings.checkNow.available.body: Version {0} is available — you can install it from the bar at the top of the window.
settings.checkNow.upToDate.title: Up to date
settings.checkNow.failed.title: Check failed
settings.logging.title: Error logging
settings.logging.desc: Writes install and scan errors (command, exit code, raw winget output) to a log file in %LocalAppData%\SetupToolbox\logs. Useful for diagnosing or reporting problems.
